title: 5 Unexpected Animal Skills, Ranked.

primary.title: 5 Unexpected Animal Skills, Ranked.
primary.description: Five real animal moments. One completely subjective ranking. A squirrel drops in, a hermit crab carries a broken shell, a periwinkle grazes along a groyne, a gorilla takes a careful snack, and two doves face off with their wings. Which one deserves number one? All picture and audio sources are CC0 1.0 via Wikimedia Commons and are credited below. No spoken voice-over, score, or added layers; only the original source audio from each moment. All five selected windows have audible native source audio. This is subjective entertainment, not a scientific claim or a claim about any individual animal life.

comments.clarifying: This is a subjective entertainment ranking using independently licensed CC0 Wikimedia Commons clips; it is not a scientific claim or a claim about any individual animal life.
